latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Best Video Script Writer — generate ready-to-use video scripts from any topic or brief in seconds.

- Instantly generate 1080p video scripts based on your prompt; supports YouTube, product explainers, and more.
- Simple onboarding — just send a topic or brief and describe your needs.
- Secure connection to backend API with automatic handling of tokens and sessions.
- Fast cloud GPU rendering for exporting finished videos (supports MP4 and more).
- Supports file uploads, timeline previews, and credit balance checks directly in chat.
- Includes clear workflows, error handling, and user guidance for seamless editing and exports.
